name.km: បាយដំណើបខ្នុរ

description: Fragrant coconut sticky rice served with jackfruit.
descriptionKm: បាយដំណើបទឹកដូងក្រអូប ផ្សំជាមួយខ្នុរ។
equipmentKm: ឆ្នាំងចំហុយ

ingredients.notesKm: ត្រាំមួយយប់
សម្រាប់បរិភោគ

instructions.text: Steam the soaked sticky rice over high heat 25–30 minutes until tender.
Warm the coconut milk with palm sugar, salt and pandan until the sugar dissolves (do not boil).
Fold most of the sweet coconut milk through the hot rice and rest 15 minutes to absorb.
instructions.tip: Keep a little coconut sauce back to spoon over at the end.

instructions.text: Serve the sticky rice with the jackfruit and the reserved coconut sauce.
